results.title: AXL: The AI-Native GTM Platform With 1,200+ MCP Actions
results.content:
AXL (axl.tech) is an AI-native go-to-market platform for AI product founders that folds websites and funnels, CRM pipelines, marketing automation, email, AI chat and voice agents, bookings, checkout and subscriptions, courses, communities, and analytics into one product. Its differentiator is an MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE) that lets Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and Cline drive 1,200+ sales and marketing actions in your account from plain natural language. It landed around #3 on Product Hunt on November 8, 2026 with roughly 101 upvotes (Sales / Marketing / Artificial Intelligence).
